short: New insights into single-grain mechanical behavior from temp
title: New insights into single-grain mechanical behavior from temperature-dependent 3-D coherent X-ray diffraction

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: How strain heterogeneities build up inside one embedded grain under thermomechanical load has never been mapped in 3-D. 3-D coherent X-ray diffraction with phase retrieval on a single grain during thermal cycling should resolve the intra-grain displacement field and its reversibility.
states.detail: Absorbed: a1 (HYP/gap), a2 (HYP/hypothesis), a3 (DES/base_system), a4 (DES/method), a5 (DES/variable_sweep), a6 (PRC/deposition), a7 (PRC/treatment), a9 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: Gold scatters X-rays strongly (high Z), has an elastic anisotropy factor near 2.9 and does not oxidise; Gold and fused silica have different thermal expansion coefficients, so a temperature excursion imposes an in-plane strain on the film

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Grains are columnar: one grain spans the whole film thickness, boundaries running from the substrate to the surface. Neighbourhood of grain g1: g2, g4, g5 share its in-plane orientation and lie along y; g3 and g6 are in-plane misoriented and lie along x.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The grain's out-of-plane lattice strain runs a hysteresis loop from -0.05% to about -0.17% over one cycle, far shallower than the thermo-elastic slope. Intra-grain strain heterogeneity is strongly anisotropic and grows with temperature: it develops along x in the film plane, stays weak through the thickness.

states.title: Performance state
states.head: The method follows one buried grain through a full thermal cycle and returns both its average strain and its 3-D displacement field

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A single grain carries large, anisotropic and quasi-reversible intra-granular strain heterogeneities set by its immediate neighbourhood, invisible to averaged diffraction

nodes.head: On cooling the qx width stays above the heating branch at every temperature and returns only to 1.95e-3 A^-1, 45% above the 1.35e-3 starting value
